other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.height:
fun height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "height Leaf = 0" |
  "height (Node l a r) = max (height l) (height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.min_height:
fun min_height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "min_height Leaf = 0" |
  "min_height (Node l _ r) = min (min_height l) (min_height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.subtrees:
fun subtrees :: "'a tree \<Rightarrow> 'a tree set" where
  "subtrees Leaf = {Leaf}" |
  "subtrees (Node l a r) = {Node l a r} \<union> subtrees l \<union> subtrees r"
formal function definitions.acomplete:
definition acomplete :: "'a tree ⇒ bool" where
  "acomplete t = (height t - min_height t ≤ 1)"

formal theorem statement: theorem acomplete_subtrees: "⟦ acomplete t; s ∈ subtrees t ⟧ ⟹ acomplete s"
